name: SikaSeal® Appliance Sealant
tagline: Premium one-component room temperature vulcanising silicone sealant
summary: SikaSeal® Appliance Silicone Sealant is a premium one-component room temperature vulcanising (RTV) silicone rubber designed for flexible gasketing and sealing applications. SikaSeal® Appliance Silicone Sealant forms a tough but flexible seal of all shapes and sizes and fills any surface voids. The cured product can withstand vibration, weathering, temperature extremes, water oil and grease without hardening, shrinking or cracking.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 18 months from date of production if in undamaged and unopened original sealed containers and stored according to the storage conditions.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Must be stored in dry conditions and protected from direct sunlight at temperatures between +10ºC and +25ºC.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Ensure all surfaces are clean, dry and free from dust, grease and loose material. Remove all old gasket material from surfaces before cleaning with a residue-free solvent and allowing to completely dry.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Uncured, excess SikaSeal® Appliance may be removed with Sika® Remover-208 or another suitable solvent. Once cured, the excess sealant can be trimmed away from the edges with a knife.
